apps.name: Anywhere
apps.subtitle: Simulate your location on iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription: Set a simulated location from the map or Shortcuts. Anywhere supports SideStore pairing import and Amap coordinate correction.

versions.localizedDescription:
Selecting a recent place now centers the map and drops a pin. Shortcut notifications for starting a simulation show the applied offset, including zero.

点按最近地点会居中并放置图钉，点右下角按钮才会启动模拟。快捷指令启动成功的通知会显示实际偏移距离，未偏移时显示 0 米。

Selecting a favorite now centers the map and drops a pin. Tap Teleport to start simulating. The clear button is hidden when there are no recent places.

点按收藏会居中并放置图钉，点右下角按钮才会开始模拟。最近地点为空时隐藏清空按钮。

Recenter now resets the map to north-up and flat. Selecting a favorite centers the map without starting a simulation. Clear recent places from the Places screen while keeping favorites.

地图居中时恢复正北朝上和俯视。点按收藏只移动地图中心。可在「我的地点」确认清空最近地点，收藏会保留。

Fixed Apple Maps and Amap shares in Shortcuts. Shortcut result notifications now replace the previous result.

修复苹果地图和高德地图分享至快捷指令的问题。快捷操作通知只保留最近一次结果。

Added an Anytime Anywhere easter egg at the bottom of Settings, featuring the Frieren anime edition cover.

设置页底部新增「Anytime Anywhere」彩蛋，展示《葬送的芙莉莲》动画限定盘封面。

First Anywhere release, with Shortcuts, SideStore pairing import, Amap coordinate correction, and Simplified Chinese localization.

Anywhere 首次发布，支持快捷指令、SideStore 配对导入、高德坐标修正和简体中文。
